Null diluted EPS is not an invented equality.,comparabilityGroup equality is a necessary safeguard, not permission to subtract periods across changed definitions; read row compatibilityNotes. Income taxes use expense-positive/credit-negative signs; netIncome is attributable to owners, not group profit including NCI.,Provider annual coverage is the annual_income endpoint. The income endpoint's Q4 observations are half-year residuals, not additional full financial years; no unsupported full-year rows are fabricated from them.,The provider income endpoint contains quarterly as well as H1 dates.
